name: MovisionXR
summary:
Movision XR was created based on the experience and daily needs identified by physiotherapists, aiming to motivate patients to perform their required rehabilitation exercises in a more engaging way.

The application offers three therapeutic activities:

Volleyball: Designed to exercise arm range of motion, precision, and reaction time through interactive and dynamic gameplay.
